MATCH_PRICE_VARIANCE.description: Invoice unit price differs from the purchase order beyond the tenant tolerance.

MATCH_QUANTITY_VARIANCE.description: Invoiced quantity exceeds the received quantity beyond the tenant tolerance.

MATCH_PO_NOT_FOUND.description: The referenced purchase order does not exist for this tenant.

MATCH_RECEIPT_MISSING.description: No goods receipt exists for one or more purchase order lines.

DUPLICATE_EXACT.description: Same vendor, normalized invoice number and amount as an existing invoice.

DUPLICATE_NEAR.description: Same vendor and amount within the duplicate window with a similar invoice number.

VENDOR_BANK_CHANGE_QUARANTINE.description: Vendor bank details changed and are inside the quarantine window.

VENDOR_UNKNOWN.description: The vendor is not in the tenant vendor master.

VENDOR_INACTIVE.description: The vendor exists but is deactivated or blocked.

VALIDATION_MISSING_FIELD.description: A required header field is missing after extraction.

VALIDATION_TOTALS_MISMATCH.description: Line totals plus tax do not equal the invoice total.

VALIDATION_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED.description: Invoice currency is not enabled in the tenant policy.

APPROVAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Invoice amount exceeds the highest approval tier in the tenant policy.

POLICY_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.description: Tenant policy requires manual review for this vendor, amount or category.

AI_EXTRACTION_LOW_CONFIDENCE.description: Extraction confidence for a money-bearing field is below the policy threshold.

AI_ANOMALY_SUSPECTED.description: The invoice is unusual for this vendor (amount, cadence or line mix).

AI_DOCUMENT_TAMPERING_SUSPECTED.description: The document shows signs of editing (fonts, overlays, metadata inconsistencies).

AI_SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE_SUSPECTED.description: The invoice is semantically similar to an existing invoice despite differing identifiers.
